notes.title: Void Memory: Addendum
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're here to announce the new expansion set of Void Memory, that we named as [b]Void Memory: Addendum[/b]. Addendum will include some quality-of-life enhancements, and tons of extra contents that will give you even more challenges.

Plus, this expansion is free for anyone who owns the game. Here's the message from the developer.

—

[i]For the last few months, I've been thinking my game as a bad one. Because of these thoughts, the update of this game was postponed forever and I was out of passion which was needed to update this game.[/i]
 
[i]Then one day, I looked at your thoughts at the reviews, plus the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/727510/announcements/detail/3297082448848669707]survey[/url] about the DLC that I opened. There were plenty of people who didn't like my game, but there were also some people who liked it. Your positive reviews and opinions made my passion to come back.[/i]
 
[i]This update, which I've been working for with all of my spare time, would be the final update of Void Memory.[/i]

[i]Originally, this update was planned to be sold as a separate DLC, but instead I decided to make the update itself free, but increased the price in return. You may think this as a gratitude, to the players who loved my game for a long time.[/i]

[i]Thank you for playing my game.[/i]
 
[i]Sincerely, Gustav.[/i]

—

As the developer mentioned too, we increased the price by $5 to give advantage for the prior customers.

Hope you enjoy the Addendum. We'll come back if we fix some critical issues or if there're some other topics to share.

Thank you very much.


[h1]Featured Contents[/h1]
[list][*] 5 new areas (You can access the new area by entering the left side of the Quarry.)
[*] 8 new bosses and 5 new mid-bosses
[*] 22 new items
[*] 16 new achievements
[*] A new ending
[*] Boss Rush, for the Hard Mode
[*] Equipments and some areas are now more balanced (Healing items are now more useful and enemies are weakened.)
[*] Interface optimization
[*] Game saving optimization
[*] Controls optimization
[*] ...and much more![/list]

notes.title: Steam Cloud, Trading Cards, etc. (Dec. 29th, 2018)
notes.content:
[h1]Steam Cloud[/h1]
Steam Cloud feature has been activated. Now your configuration and saved progress will be backed up automatically.


[h1]Steam Trading Cards[/h1]
Trading Cards are finally here! We have 7 cards in total, plus 5 Steam Profile Backgrounds and 6 emoticons.
[list][*][b]Cards[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941040/7395050ff00c32a74d33779bc54054ed63f7a957.png[/img]
[*][b]Badges[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941040/56dae065ce6bbbd6eb38e80d21256a767e67acbe.png[/img]

[*][b]Profile Backgrounds[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941040/3d3eadb167d0f46cac4fb44ffc892262549b5c20.png[/img]
[*][b]Emoticons[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941040/434b95609f8dc608bac86fd3c239814ae2db3d91.png[/img][/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an occasional issue where Priestess Grace disappears permanently when the player character exits the boss room during the fight.

[*]Fixed a V-sync issue that made the game sped up when it's played on a monitor with a refresh rate higher than 60 Hz.[/list]
